title: Design: A/R Customer chip and menu match Sales By Customer's
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has open invoices on today's date and a long name (more than 40 characters).
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-31 Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment and Trailer Repair.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Reports > Finance > Sales By Customer is open in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the Customer chip and compare with Sales By Customer's.
  2. Click it and read the menu, row by row, letter for letter.
  3. Tick {Customer-A} and look at the chip.
  4. Compare the open menu with Sales By Customer's open Customer menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Customer: All customers" with the person icon, in the resting (grey) style, as on Sales By Customer.
  • Step 2: in this order: a search box, "All customers", the line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then the customers.
  • Step 3: the chip shows the name shortened with "..." and leaves the resting style.
  • Step 4: the same menu: rows, order, tick boxes, spacing and position.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), page 7 (Filters and call list) as the PRD names it. When the design is driven, its picture of this screen is attached here, every attribute is re-checked against it, and any difference gets a sent question and a held design-version case (Rules 120, 126, 130).
